instruction: look at drill_plate.step. Create spot drilling and through drilling operations at the four hole centers (+25,+15), (+25,-15), (-25,+15), and (-25,-15). The drilling operation must break through the bottom by 1 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is a 90 degree spot drill at S8000 rpm and F250 mm/min; T2 is a 5 mm drill at S5000 rpm and F180 mm/min. In the NC Program or post-process dialog, use metric units and the selected post processor for this setup, then export task-3.nc to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths.
